record.name: Lumen
record.appearance: adult woman, 28; blue-black hair with teal understrands and a side bun, gentle pink eyes, high white collar, white and pink medical corset, plaid hip skirt, black harnesses, long holographic coat, white armored thigh-high boots, a Vitas rail rifle and a six-petal pink and mint healing drone; the drone is a construct, not her transformed body

passive.name: aftercare
passive.description: Healing an ally, including erasing a Pending Wound, grants that ally a 30-point barrier for 4 s (120 ticks), once per recipient every 3 s (90 ticks). Repeated small heals cannot stack shields. Refreshing replaces the previous barrier rather than adding to it.
passive.notes: Core rule (skill-paradigms.md): Pending Wounds. Sanctuary delays some real incoming health damage into visible pink Wound Petals, each retaining its victim and a 2 s (60 ticks) countdown, then dealing its exact unpaid amount. Lumen's healing erases pending damage before restoring health. Enemy shots may force settlement early but never add damage. Pending debt caps at 25% of the owner's maximum health; overflow lands immediately. Leaving the zone, cleansing, the drone ending or Lumen's defeat forgives no debt. Settled damage cannot be deferred again. Ordinary shields resolve before wounds are created. Dressing petals are not shootable by enemies and carry no hit points (hp 0 is a placeholder). Transfer of a dressing is not healing and cannot trigger Aftercare again. Passive forms carry rules, not a skill behaviour: the draft form behaviour was removed on promotion; it recorded rank 0 healTrigger = "on healing an ally or erasing a Pending Wound; once per recipient every 90 ticks; replaces the previous barrier" (schema cannot express a heal-received trigger with a per-recipient limit: healing an ally, including erasing a Pending Wound, grants that ally the barrier once per recipient every 3 s (90 ticks); repeated small heals cannot stack shields and a refresh replaces the previous barrier.); rank 0 effects[0].recipient.radius = 0 (the recipient is the healed or struck ally, so no search radius applies; 0 is a placeholder.); rank 3 healTrigger = "on healing an ally or erasing a Pending Wound; once per recipient every 90 ticks; replaces the previous barrier" (schema cannot express a heal-received trigger with a per-recipient limit: healing an ally, including erasing a Pending Wound, grants that ally the barrier once per recipient every 3 s (90 ticks); repeated small heals cannot stack shields and a refresh replaces the previous barrier.); rank 3 effects[0].recipient.radius = 0 (the recipient is the healed or struck ally, so no search radius applies; 0 is a placeholder.); rank 3 secondary[0].effects[0].perApplication = 30 (the dressing is worth the barrier remaining at expiry, at most 30; 30 is the maximum and the amount shrinks with damage taken before expiry.); rank 3 dressingClaim = "claimed deliberately by a different ally within 600 cm" (schema cannot express a deliberate claim by a different ally: a different ally within 6 m (600 cm) may claim the Dressing Petal for 3 s (90 ticks).); rank 5 healTrigger = "on healing an ally or erasing a Pending Wound; once per recipient every 90 ticks; replaces the previous barrier" (schema cannot express a heal-received trigger with a per-recipient limit: healing an ally, including erasing a Pending Wound, grants that ally the barrier once per recipient every 3 s (90 ticks); repeated small heals cannot stack shields and a refresh replaces the previous barrier.); rank 5 effects[0].recipient.radius = 0 (the recipient is the healed or struck ally, so no search radius applies; 0 is a placeholder.); rank 5 secondary[0].effects[0].perApplication = 30 (the drone stores up to three unclaimed dressings of at most 30 each (90 barrier total) for 6 s (180 ticks).); rank 5 dressingCabinet = "primary aimed at a stored mint petal delivers it to a chosen ally" (schema cannot express a primary sending a stored dressing: a primary aimed at a stored mint petal sends that dressing to a chosen ally in sight, spends the attack and creates no replacement dressing.).

mechanics.stock: Healing an ally, including erasing a Pending Wound, grants that ally a 30-point barrier for 4 s (120 ticks), once per recipient every 3 s (90 ticks). Repeated small heals cannot stack shields. Refreshing replaces the previous barrier rather than adding to it.
counterplay: Mint petals store shielding while pink petals store debt: separate Lumen from sight lines, pressure the drone and force wounds to settle before treatment.

forms.description: Healing an ally, including erasing a Pending Wound, grants that ally a 30-point barrier for 4 s (120 ticks), once per recipient every 3 s (90 ticks). Repeated small heals cannot stack shields. Refreshing replaces the previous barrier rather than adding to it.

forms.name: unused dressing
forms.description: Aftercare expiring with barrier remaining leaves a mint Dressing Petal worth that remainder, maximum 30, for 3 s (90 ticks). A different ally within 6 m (600 cm) may deliberately claim it as a barrier. Transfer is not healing and cannot trigger Aftercare again. Damage taken before expiry leaves less to pass on.

forms.name: spare-parts ward
forms.description: The drone can collect three unclaimed dressings, 90 barrier total, for 6 s (180 ticks). A primary deliberately aimed at a stored mint petal sends that dressing to a chosen ally in sight. This spends the attack and creates no replacement dressing. The drone becomes a visible, limited cabinet of protection.

basic.name: light stitch
basic.description: Fire a bolt dealing 45 damage to an enemy up to 9 m (900 cm) away. Alternatively, aim at a friendly pink Wound Petal to erase 45 pending damage. Treating spends the attack: it does not also hit an enemy. She can literally shoot an injury before it finishes happening.
basic.effect: Fire a bolt dealing 45 damage to an enemy up to 9 m (900 cm) away. Alternatively, aim at a friendly pink Wound Petal to erase 45 pending damage. Treating spends the attack: it does not also hit an enemy. She can literally shoot an injury before it finishes happening.
basic.notes: Source primary: 45 damage to an enemy up to 9 m (900 cm), or 45 pending damage erased on a friendly Wound Petal. R3: an enemy-directed bolt passes through one ally, healing 20, before continuing for its original 45; direct treatment still erases 45 without a free additional patient. R5: treatment splits between two visible friendly petals within 4 m (400 cm), earlier countdown first; the stitch cannot cross cover.

dossier.identity: injury intercept medic operator who shoots pending wounds before they finish happening and treats several patients on one exposed healing drone
dossier.selectionRationale: The 2026-11-07 dossier proposals (docs/dossier-proposals/2026-11-07) make Lumen an operator whose healing arrives before damage settles: Wound Petals delay real damage, her shots erase them, and mint dressings store shielding. It is a bounded intercept loop with no revival, distinct from nyra's emergency saves and fable's preventative overflow shields.
dossier.weaponConcept: vitas rail (modular medic rail rifle that channels stabilizing light and deploys healing constructs; scope module, healing-rail barrel unit, lumens-fluid energy chamber, recoil-damp stock) with a six-petal healer drone
dossier.loreStatus: draft lore composed from the supplied dossier sheet and the 2026-11-07 proposals; not owner-reviewed

lore.backstory: Lumen works in the gap between a wound landing and a wound being felt. Her rail rifle carries stabilizing light, and the six-petal drone that follows her turns a patch of ruin into a place to operate.
lore.syndicateRecord: No syndicate record in the supplied sheet; she is listed as a field medic of the ruined cities, unaffiliated.
lore.psychProfile: Gentle and exact: she counts debts in seconds, treats patients in order of countdown, and does not promise what the clock will not allow.
lore.combatQuote: “even in ruins, there is still light to share.”

dossier.identity: injury intercept medic operator who shoots pending wounds before they finish happening and treats several patients on one exposed healing drone
dossier.selectionRationale: The 2026-11-07 dossier proposals (docs/dossier-proposals/2026-11-07) make Lumen an operator whose healing arrives before damage settles: Wound Petals delay real damage, her shots erase them, and mint dressings store shielding. It is a bounded intercept loop with no revival, distinct from nyra's emergency saves and fable's preventative overflow shields.
dossier.weaponConcept: vitas rail (modular medic rail rifle that channels stabilizing light and deploys healing constructs; scope module, healing-rail barrel unit, lumens-fluid energy chamber, recoil-damp stock) with a six-petal healer drone
dossier.loreStatus: draft lore composed from the supplied dossier sheet and the 2026-11-07 proposals; not owner-reviewed

lore.backstory: Lumen works in the gap between a wound landing and a wound being felt. Her rail rifle carries stabilizing light, and the six-petal drone that follows her turns a patch of ruin into a place to operate.
lore.syndicateRecord: No syndicate record in the supplied sheet; she is listed as a field medic of the ruined cities, unaffiliated.
lore.psychProfile: Gentle and exact: she counts debts in seconds, treats patients in order of countdown, and does not promise what the clock will not allow.
lore.combatQuote: “even in ruins, there is still light to share.”

Subject: a bold petal drone holding a single chunky ray of light over a broken arch. Centered compact square silhouette, fills 82% of canvas.
